index_record.dataset_generation_caption:
The figure presents a hierarchical flowchart illustrating an Employee Wellness AI Framework, structured as a top-down decision and implementation pathway. The global layout is a tree-like diagram with a single root node at the top, branching into two primary objectives, which converge into a central system node, further dividing into three functional subsystems, each leading to a specific outcome module. All nodes are rectangular boxes with rounded corners, outlined in blue on the left and red on the right, creating a dual-color border effect, and filled with white background. Text within each box is centered, black, and uses a clean sans-serif font.

At the top, the starting point is labeled 'Start: AI Integration', serving as the initial trigger for the framework. From this node, two directed arrows branch downward to two parallel objective nodes: 'Optimize Productivity' on the left and 'Enhance Employee Well-Being' on the right. These two objectives represent the dual goals driving the AI integration strategy.

Both objective nodes feed into a central convergence node labeled 'AI-Driven System', indicating that the combined focus on productivity and well-being is implemented through a unified AI system. From this central node, three distinct pathways diverge horizontally to the bottom tier, each representing a core functional area of the system: 'Cognitive Tools' on the left, 'Mental Health' in the center, and 'Employee Engagement' on the right.

Each of these three functional areas leads to a final outcome or subsystem module. Specifically, 'Cognitive Tools' connects to 'Neuroeconomic Model', suggesting a model that integrates cognitive processes with economic behavior. 'Mental Health' connects to 'Gamification Subsystem', implying the use of game design elements to support mental wellness. 'Employee Engagement' connects to 'Task Prioritization', indicating a mechanism for improving engagement by intelligently managing workloads.

All connections are represented by solid black lines with classic arrowheads pointing from source to destination, clearly indicating the direction of flow and dependency. The diagram does not include any mathematical equations or LaTeX expressions, but the caption 'Overview of Employee Wellness AI Framework' situates the figure as a high-level architectural representation of how AI can be integrated to simultaneously improve organizational productivity and employee well-being through targeted subsystems.
